item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 10/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be generally fine and hot over Guangdong in the next couple of days. Winds will be weak and the visibility will be relatively low. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier and cloudier with a few showers over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. Tropical Cyclone Megi will move slowly today and tomorrow and then move east, weakening gradually. Tropical Cyclone Malakas will intensify gradually and move across the western North Pacific in the next couple of days. It will then move north and affect the seas south of Japan.
